en-US.longDescription: Instantly create and manage QR codes right from your PowerToys Command Palette—no need to open another app or website. Requires Microsoft PowerToys. This handy extension empowers you to generate QR codes for URLs, text, and more with just a few keystrokes. Whether you're sharing information with colleagues or quickly transferring data to your mobile device, it's the fastest way to get it done.
en-US.name: QR Codes for Command Palette
